items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman: 'We will remain in this compute shortage no matter what'
items.summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says AI-driven computing constraints will last for the foreseeable future.

items.title: 2 reasons why Microsoft belongs in your portfolio: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria
items.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to explain why Microsoft (MSFT) is a top AI stock, arguing that its multi-year access to OpenAI’s technology and the rise of open-source models make owning a proprietary frontier model unnecessary.

items.title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines AMD's latest raft of microprocessors and other products that aim to put it in direct competition with chip competitor Nvidia (NVDA). AMD is currently scheduled to report second quarter earnings on Tuesday, August 4, well ahead of Nvidia's earnings release expected out on Wednesday, August 26.

items.title: Meta is naming its multibillion-dollar AI debt deals after different types of fried dough
items.summary: Meta’s latest corporate bonds earmarked for AI data center spending are called Beignet Investor and Sopaipilla Investor, after two popular sweet treats popular in these states.

items.title: Meta's AI Borrowing Costs Rise on $12 Billion Data Center Deal
items.summary: Bond investors are repricing AI infrastructure risk

items.title: Meta Set Its AI Budget to as Much as $145 Billion. Investors Aren't Sure They Like It.
items.summary: The AI budget keeps growing. The stock hasn't kept up. Investors will be looking for answers in Meta's earnings report next week.

items.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
items.summary: AI companies, including Nvidia and Mistral, urge policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI and alleged model distillation.

items.title: Meta Launches Seller App To Boost Facebook Marketplace
items.summary: Meta Platforms is launching a dedicated app for sellers on Facebook Marketplace.  Meta stock was a fraction higher midday Friday while the news appeared to weigh on eBay shares.  The new app will be called Seller, according to an announcement from Meta on Friday morning.
